title: Lorentzian Jensen-Bregman metric principle
context_tex: A homogeneous polynomial with nonnegative coefficients is \emph{Lorentzian} in the sense of Br\"and\'en and Huh \cite{BrandenHuh} if all its second-order directional derivatives, taken at positive arguments, are quadratic forms of Lorentzian signature $(+,-,\ldots,-)$; in two variables, a form $\sum_{k}a_kx^ky^{d-k}$ is strictly Lorentzian exactly when the normalized coefficients $a_k/\binom dk$ are strictly log-concave, which is the criterion used below.  Lorentzian polynomials are log-concave on the positive orthant, so $F=-\log G$ is convex there and every midpoint Jensen gap $\J_G$ is nonnegative.  Recall that $d$ is a \emph{semimetric} when it is symmetric, nonnegative, vanishes only on equal arguments, and satisfies the triangle inequality; the triangle inequality is the property that fails below.  In the geometric statement, $K+L=\{k+\ell:k\in K,\ \ell\in L\}$ is the Minkowski sum of convex bodies and $\Vol$ is Lebesgue volume.

results.statement_tex: Lorentzian Jensen--Bregman metric principle: $\sqrt{\J_G}$ a semimetric for every homogeneous Lorentzian $G$
results.certificate_tex: Strictly Lorentzian rational cubic and three rational points; exact rational triangle-violation bound $>7.15\times10^{-3}$.

provenance.source_tex: S.~Sra, standalone problem; formulation as recorded in \S1 of the case's \path{paper.tex}
provenance.statement_tex:
Let $\mathcal C\subset\R^m$ be an open convex cone, let $G:\mathcal C\to(0,\infty)$, and put $F=-\log G$ and
\[\J_G(x,y):=\frac{F(x)+F(y)}2-F\!\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right).\]
If $G$ is homogeneous and Lorentzian, then $d_G:=\sqrt{\J_G}$ is a semimetric.

results.statement_tex: Log-volume midpoint gap as a squared distance on convex bodies \cite{Shephard}
results.certificate_tex: Shephard realization of the same cubic as a Steiner polynomial in $\R^3$; the violation transfers verbatim.

provenance.source_tex: S.~Sra, standalone problem (geometric specialization of the same principle); formulation as recorded in \S1 of the case's \path{paper.tex}
provenance.statement_tex:
The log-volume midpoint gap is the square of a distance on convex bodies: that is,
\[d_{\Vol}(K,L):=\left[\log\Vol\!\left(\frac{K+L}{2}\right)-\tfrac12\log\Vol(K)-\tfrac12\log\Vol(L)\right]^{1/2}\]
is a semimetric on convex bodies.

artifacts.description: Exact rational triangle-inequality violation bound with the three witness points.
